verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a desktop Linux distribution built on Hyprland, so using a paired tablet as a secondary display is a fair window-management question. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions tablet pairing, virtual or secondary displays, or screen extension. The tiling and layout keybindings cover window arrangement only, not display extension to another device, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a designer, I can use a paired tablet device as a secondary display for creative apps
